action.objective: Escape check with the king while accepting that Black has a forced short mate; no safer legal move exists.
action.rationale: Both legal moves are proven refuted: e3e4 allows ...Nf6# and f1f3 allows ...Qxf3#. unavoidable_mate is true, so no safe escape exists. e3e4 is the only commit_ready move and keeps the king more central with a defender on c3, whereas f1f3 blocks the f1 rook and allows the queen mate. I therefore commit e3e4, acknowledging the forced mate is unavoidable. No continuation supplied since the position is lost.
